# SMART Goal (template)

> Fill placeholders only. Keep headers and order intact.

**Doel:** [one-sentence goal]

- **Specifiek:** [what exactly]
- **Meetbaar:** [indicator / target]
- **Haalbaar:** [why realistic given capacity]
